**[1]** Tiangolo, Sebastián. "OAuth2 with Password (and hashing), Bearer with JWT tokens."
*FastAPI Official Documentation*, n.d.
<https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/tutorial/security/oauth2-jwt/>

prevention via dummy hash verification.

**[13]** Shatnawi, A.S.; Al-Duwairi, B.; Samarneh, A.A. "Comprehensive Empirical Study
of Python JWT Libraries." *Procedia Computer Science*, vol. 238, pp. 827-832, 2024.
DOI: 10.1016/j.procs.2024.06.099.
<https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S1877050924013358>
**Tier:** 1
Data extracted: Peer-reviewed study comparing PyJWT, python-jose, authlib, jwcrypto
via SAST tools (Bandit), PEP8 compliance, GitHub metrics. python-jose had B110 warnings
(pass in except blocks). Recommends well-tested libraries over native implementations.

**[14]** "RFC 9700: Best Current Practice for OAuth 2.0 Security."
*IETF*, January 2025.
<https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9700/>
**Tier:** 1
Data extracted: Refresh tokens for public clients MUST be sender-constrained or use
rotation. PKCE mandatory for public clients. Prohibits resource owner password credentials
grant. Mandates exact redirect URI matching.

**[15]** "Refresh token rotation." *Okta Developer Documentation*, n.d.
<https://developer.okta.com/docs/guides/refresh-tokens/main/>
**Tier:** 2
Data extracted: Rotation mechanics, grace period 0-60s (default 30s), reuse detection
invalidates entire token family, System Log events for detection,
refresh token default lifetime unlimited but expires after 7 days of non-use.

**[16]** "Automated JSON Web Key Rotation." *Zalando Engineering Blog*, Jan 2025.
<https://engineering.zalando.com/posts/2025/01/automated-json-web-key-rotation.html>
**Tier:** 3
Data extracted: Four-phase rotation (generation, publication, grace period, activation
+ retirement), key removal formula (retirement time + max token lifespan + safety margin),
cache-control headers matter for JWKS endpoints.

**[17]** "Revoking Access With a JWT Blacklist." *SuperTokens Blog*, n.d.
<https://supertokens.com/blog/revoking-access-with-a-jwt-blacklist>
**Tier:** 3
Data extracted: Seven revocation strategies (blacklisting, short-lived tokens, secret
rotation, token versioning, forced logout, TRL, refresh token strategy), Redis for
minimal latency lookups, hybrid cache+DB approach.

**[23]** "JWT Token Storage: localStorage vs Cookies."

**[28]** "JWT Algorithm Confusion Attacks: CVE-2026-22817, CVE-2026-27804, CVE-2026-23552."

**Tier:** 3
Data extracted: CVE-2026-22817 (Hono, CVSS 8.2) — alg header not pinned;
CVE-2026-27804 (Parse Server, CVSS 9.3) — none + HS256 confusion, full account takeover;
CVE-2026-23552 (Apache Camel Keycloak, CVSS 9.1) — issuer claim not validated.
Mitigation: pin algorithms server-side, reject none case-insensitively, validate iss+aud.
